# Generate `PRD.md` and `TRD.md`

Use `IDEATION.md`, the prepared datasets, setup guides, and scaffolded Aspire solution to define a workshop-sized Smart Parking Navigator MVP. Generate only `PRD.md` and `TRD.md`; do not implement application behavior in this issue. Make sure to include metadata of both `PRD.md` and `TRD.md` for tracking history.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `PRD.md` defines target users, the Singapore context, user journeys, MVP scope, exclusions, and measurable acceptance criteria.
- [ ] The MVP covers destination search, nearby HDB car parks, live lot availability, basic filters, details, and freshness states.
- [ ] `TRD.md` assigns clear responsibilities to WebApp, ApiApp, AppHost, and ServiceDefaults.
- [ ] `TRD.md` defines HDB CSV ingestion, data.gov.sg polling, SVY21 conversion, joining, distance calculation, API boundaries, error handling, and tests.
- [ ] Google Maps and data.gov.sg credentials remain in their appropriate frontend/backend boundaries.
- [ ] Deployment, databases, and MCP are out of scope, and agentic AI is deferred to the step 05 capstone.
